protocol.resume: Retain all earlier terminal games. Resume each unfinished game from its saved position and history, using a declared new random seed. No draw/resignation adjudication.
protocol.scope: Stockfish-preset-relative standard chess at 150 ms/move. Not application default/full-budget or custom-turn Elo. The same Stockfish implementation supplies all anchors; presets are not an independently calibrated human pool.
